    Infineon’s 600 V and 650 V CoolMOS™ C7 superjunction (SJ) MOSFET families are designed to achieve record-level efficiency performance, with reduced losses over the whole load range in hard-switching applications.

    Features

    • Reduced switching losses
    • Excellent figure of merit Q G*R DS(on)
    • Increased switching frequency
    • Best R (on)*A in the market
    • Rugged body diode

    Benefits

    • Higher frequency with no efficiency loss
    • Extended part-load efficiency
    • 50% smaller magnetic components
    • Smaller packages for same RDS(on)
    • Versatile for Hard and Soft Switching

    Applications

    General purpose motor drive
    Intermediate Bus Converter (IBC)
